overview.description: The Kurv Equity Option Income ETF (KEO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds, seeking current income, with total return as a secondary objective. The fund holds affiliate KURV ETFs that provide exposure to individual stocks, metals, or fixed-income securities. KEO was launched on Aug 4, 2026 and is issued by Kurv.
